description: This file defines a controller class for the Sale Coupon report in an OpenCart admin extension. It handles displaying the report form, saving settings, and generating the report data as views or JSON responses.

classes.name: SaleCoupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Sale Coupon report in the admin panel, including viewing, saving settings, and listing coupon data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale coupon report form with breadcrumb navigation and configuration settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the sale coupon report view with data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the coupon report data as a view, including pagination and filtering.
